t: Site Arenite safety boots offer essential foot protection for demanding work environments. These durable boots feature a robust nubuck leather upper and a steel toe cap providing 200 joules of impact resistance, ideal for construction sites and workshops. The SRA anti-slip and oil-repellent soles ensure secure footing on various surfaces, while the padded collar and tongue, combined with a breathable mesh lining and EVA insole, deliver lasting comfort throughout the workday. A reinforced heel and shock-absorbing heel further enhance durability and reduce fatigue.
b: Not Tested for Sole Heat Resistance
